decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The works to which this consent relates, must be begun not later than the expiration of five years beginning with the date of this consent.
Condition : 2 - No service outlets,vents,rainwater hoppers, outlets, or downpipes shall penetrate or show on the wall facing the highway, or onto the garden.

Condition : 3 - Detailed drawings of construction, decorative brickwork (if any) and coping to the wall shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the relevant parts of the works hereby approved are commenced.

Condition : 4 - Sample panels of facing brickwork, showing the proposed colour, texture, face-bond and pointing shall be provided on site and approved by the Local Planning Authority in writing before the relevant part of the works hereby approved are commenced; and the sample panels shall be retained on site until the work has been completed and has been approved.
description: Demolition of existing garages and orangery, erection of new garage, single storey garden store, and recreational / multi purpose garden building to existing dwellinghouse
